objective.title: Qualify M2 mathematical IR/composition preview with six-phase evidence, cross-layer tests and isolated local NuGet consumer

declared.summary: Independently qualify the six completed M2 phases and twelve task contracts, run eight new cross-layer IR/composition tests and all composition/IR/quantities/foundation regressions, package three locked local Math NuGets, verify each manifest's dependency graph and SHA-256, then compile and execute an isolated .NET 10 NuGet-only consumer before closing the M2 milestone.
declared.value: A verified local preview of bounded typed IR and deterministic provider-neutral exact composition with reproducible exact replay, independent of AURA and from direct project references, can be consumed through transitive NuGet packages.
debtChanges: M2 closure covers the accepted preview only; M3 numerical algorithms, M4 symbolic algorithms, M5 interoperability and external AURA adoption remain open/planned.
Structural hashes are canonical tree identities, not algebraic equivalence proofs; binary64 cross-platform bit-for-bit portability remains unqualified.
NuGet artifacts are verified local ignored outputs with observed SHA-256, not publicly published or installed in AURA.
Provider description, versioned identity and local replay do not grant provider execution, AURA permission or remote/distributed service guarantees.

RS038 retry 0 failed before attempt allocation: authoring preflight refused direct filesystem mutations and JsonArray.Add in the C# payload. Retry 1 stages a separate NuGet-only consumer via the Payload SDK, uses an AOT-safe JSON array factory, and preserves the same six-phase M2 gate.

A persistent, standalone NuGet-only smoke-consumer fixture under tests/consumers is installed by the typed Payload SDK and excluded from the solution; its restore is restricted to the locally generated package feed.

RS038 retry 1 failed before allocation: CS0119 at payload.cs:146 because Version resolved as the .NET type, not a package constant. Retry 2 uses the explicit CompositionVersion; gate scope and fixtures remain unchanged.
RS038 retry 2 failed before allocation: a contribution debtChanges entry exceeded DWF's 300-character limit. Retry 3 corrects the metadata only; no functional or payload changes.
declared.nextAction: After qualified M2 gate success, inspect DWF milestone transition and prepare the next substantial admissible M3-W01-C01 phase from its accepted backlog; keep M3 scientific scope and independent RED/GREEN evidence bounded.

achievements.achievement: The M2 six-phase preview gate is qualified by complete native/product evidence, eight independent cross-layer contract tests, full local regressions, a locked three-package NuGet dependency graph with observed hashes, and a clean isolated consumer; M3 and external AURA adoption are not claimed.
